concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a slim MOUNTAIN GOAT warrior with branching twig antlers, a leaf mane and a bark chest guard, the THIRD stage of a three-stage Wood evolution line whose first stage is image 6 (the round goat kid), in the same view and pose as image 1, standing tall on four slim legs, body turned to the viewer-right, head raised, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 head with face; 2 slim body and neck; 3 leaf mane on the neck and back; 4 bark chest guard; 5 branching twig antlers; 6 daisy ring; 7 tail; 8 four slim legs; 9 four hooves;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 head with face: a slim goat head: chestnut-brown face with a pale cream muzzle tip and chin, a small olive leaf forelock on top where the old green hair starts, one honey-amber eye (one catchlight dot) exactly where the old eye is, brow angled down, mouth in a confident half-smile.
2 slim body and neck: a slim mountain-goat body with the same outline: warm cream fur; the green tops of the torso, neck and haunch become olive-green and lime-yellow leaves (part of the leaf mane); the front of the neck and the chest cream.
3 leaf mane on the neck and back: a mane of olive-green and lime-yellow leaves (each leaf one flat colour) in the same places and pointing the same way; no peach, no gradients.
4 bark chest guard: a chest guard of grey-brown tree bark with a leaf carved on it (the carved leaf olive green), hung by two bark straps in the same places, about the same size; no gold, no metal.
5 branching twig antlers: branching wooden twig antlers like a deer's: each horn becomes a dark-brown branch sweeping back and up with forked tines and small fresh light-green leaf buds, and the two sprouts become two extra thin dark-brown twig tines with a leaf bud at the tip, rising from the top of the head; no curls, no gold ring.
6 daisy ring: a ring of yellow daisies with orange-brown centres and a few olive leaves, sitting on top of the head between the antlers in the same place; no pink.
7 tail: a short tufted goat tail of cream wool with an olive leaf at the tip, pointing back to the viewer-left the same way.
8 four slim legs: four slim goat legs with the same outline, warm cream fur; no leaves.
9 four hooves: four small dark-brown split goat hooves at the bottom of the legs, in the same places; no leaves.

ATTITUDE: a proud goat warrior ready to charge: brow angled down, a calm confident half-smile; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those. Image 6 is the approved first stage of this creature: keep its colours, face and drawing style; this stage is the same creature grown up.

COLOURS: warm cream fur, a chestnut-brown face with a pale cream muzzle, a mane of olive-green and lime-yellow leaves, dark-brown wooden twig antlers with small fresh light-green leaf buds, a ring of yellow daisies with orange-brown centres, a grey-brown tree-bark chest guard with a carved olive leaf, dark-brown hooves, honey-amber eyes. Few colours.

AVOID: green or bush-like wool, round curled light-tan ram horns, roses, lilies, pink or pastel-pink flowers, curly yellow-green stamens or antennae, gold armour or gold rings, an all-white or all-cream face, peach-tinted leaves, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
